svg.title: Repository matrix rendered as isometric solids
svg.desc: An isometric field of 31 solids, one per public repository, each coloured by its leading language and raised to the log of its byte count. The two tallest are Network-Analyzer at 920,091 bytes and camera-count-tool at 452,139 bytes.
